name: Plague Doctor
ability: When you die, the Storyteller gains a Minion ability.
wakes: never (a gained night ability is used by the Storyteller at that Minion's night-order position)
drunk_or_poisoned: If the Plague Doctor is drunk or poisoned when they die, the Storyteller gains no ability. Becoming drunk later does not remove an already-gained ability.

jinxes.text: If the Storyteller would gain the Baron ability, up to two players become Outsiders.
If the Storyteller would gain the Boomdandy ability, a player becomes the Boomdandy.
If the Storyteller would gain the Fearmonger ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.
If the Storyteller would gain the Goblin ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.
If the Storyteller would gain the Marionette ability, one of the Demon's good neighbors becomes the Marionette.
If the Storyteller would gain the Scarlet Woman ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.
If the Storyteller would gain the Spy ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.

rulings.text: The Storyteller does not become evil, a player, or a valid target, and cannot vote or nominate. The ability lasts for the rest of the game.
The gained ability may duplicate an in-play Minion (e.g. two Cerenovus effects after a Pit-Hag).
A later drunk effect on the dead Plague Doctor (e.g. Minstrel) does not remove the gained ability.

test_scenarios.name: Gains Poisoner
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Plague Doctor, Bob Imp, Carol Spy.
test_scenarios.actions: Alice is executed day 1; Storyteller picks Poisoner.
test_scenarios.expected: From night 2 the Storyteller poisons a player each night at the Poisoner's position.

test_scenarios.name: Drunk at death
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Plague Doctor, made drunk by a dead Sweetheart.

test_scenarios.name: Spy jinx
test_scenarios.actions: Alice dies; Storyteller would gain Spy.
test_scenarios.expected: Carol gains the Spy ability and learns this.

test_scenarios.name: Baron jinx
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Plague Doctor, Dave Chef, Erin Empath.
test_scenarios.actions: Alice dies; Storyteller would gain Baron.
test_scenarios.expected: Up to two players (e.g. Dave, Erin) become Outsiders.
